#### Veeam

**Users**

This dashboard gives visibility into user, identity, and access events in the Veeam event data stream. It highlights total events and unique users, trends over time, and Event ID breakdowns. It surfaces MFA, four-eyes approvals, role changes, and REST token activity, along with top users, operations, and source IPs. Use the controls above to filter by Event ID and host. Together, these panels offer a user-administration view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
